executiveSummary.headline: Principal Platform Engineering Leader driving enterprise-scale infrastructure modernization, developer platforms, and AI-ready systems.
executiveSummary.summary: Platform Engineering leader with 15+ years of experience architecting secure, resilient, and highly automated infrastructure platforms across fintech, healthcare, media, and global enterprise environments. Specialized in infrastructure modernization, DevSecOps transformation, release engineering, CI/CD governance, reliability engineering, and AI-ready platform enablement. Proven track record leading mission-critical platform initiatives supporting global payment infrastructure, reducing operational risk, improving deployment velocity, and enabling large-scale engineering execution.

experience.role: Lead Platforms Engineer / Principal Architect (Platform Engineering & Edge Infrastructure)
experience.summary: Leading platform engineering and infrastructure modernization initiatives for Mastercard's global Edge Platform supporting 200+ payment gateway endpoints processing mission-critical financial transactions worldwide.
highlights: Led enterprise-scale modernization of 200+ Virtual MIP nodes from CentOS 7 to Oracle Linux 8 with zero data loss and uninterrupted payment processing.
Architected physical-to-virtual infrastructure transformation across 200+ global endpoints, increasing platform scalability by 300% while improving deployment consistency.
Designed and implemented centralized Next-Generation Certificate Management System (NECMS) integrating Venafi and Ansible for automated mTLS lifecycle management under PCI compliance requirements.
Reduced upgrade cycles from 2 weeks to 1 day and configuration time from 2 days to 30 minutes through automation-driven deployment engineering.
Improved operational reliability and reduced customer-impacting incidents by implementing advanced monitoring, alerting, and resilience engineering practices.
Collaborated across infrastructure, compliance, security, and engineering teams to define platform governance standards and modernization roadmaps.
Led platform enablement initiatives improving deployment scalability, operational consistency, and engineering efficiency across globally distributed infrastructure.
Drove infrastructure automation strategy using Ansible and enterprise CI/CD tooling to reduce operational risk and accelerate delivery velocity.

experience.summary: Led deployment engineering and API platform modernization initiatives for Mastercard's next-generation gateway infrastructure.
highlights: Led a team of 6 engineers deploying high-throughput NGINX Plus API Gateway infrastructure supporting millions of requests daily.
Designed zero-downtime CI/CD deployment pipelines using Chef Habitat and XL Release improving release reliability and operational consistency.
Reduced policy deployment costs by 30% and deployment errors by 90% through automation and release engineering improvements.
Collaborated with platform and application teams to standardize deployment workflows and operational practices.

experience.summary: Architected enterprise CI/CD and release engineering solutions for financial services infrastructure modernization.
highlights: Designed and implemented 20+ enterprise CI/CD pipelines reducing release cycles from 6 weeks to 2 weeks.
Delivered approximately $75,000 savings per release through automation and deployment optimization.
Engineered branching and release governance strategies reducing merge conflicts by 82%.
Implemented automated database deployment workflows using Flyway DB reducing deployment time by 75%.

experience.summary: Architected scalable content platform infrastructure supporting high-traffic digital media systems.
highlights: Architected headless Drupal/MEAN infrastructure reducing time-to-market by 50% while lowering operational costs.
Automated infrastructure provisioning and operations using Python and Ansible improving reliability and scalability.
Reduced environment provisioning time by 75% through infrastructure automation and platform standardization.

experience.summary: Implemented enterprise identity and access management automation across large-scale infrastructure environments.
highlights: Implemented Centrify IAM automation across 6,000 servers significantly improving provisioning efficiency and compliance operations.
Reduced security incidents and vulnerability remediation timelines through automation and governance improvements.
Automated Active Directory integration and compliance reporting workflows.

experience.summary: Led cloud migration and observability initiatives for globally distributed infrastructure platforms.
highlights: Led AWS migration and performance optimization initiatives improving platform responsiveness and reducing infrastructure costs.
Implemented AppDynamics and Splunk observability solutions reducing incident resolution time and improving operational visibility.
Delivered highly available cloud infrastructure supporting critical enterprise services.

experience.summary: Designed deployment automation and hybrid cloud enablement solutions for enterprise financial systems.
highlights: Developed enterprise deployment blueprints using Puppet, Git, and infrastructure automation tooling.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines supporting Java, .NET, and Unix application deployments.
Built automation utilities and REST APIs improving deployment standardization and operational efficiency.

experience.summary: Managed large-scale configuration management and automation systems supporting Disney Parks & Resorts infrastructure.
highlights: Managed Configuration-as-a-Service operations supporting 5,000+ enterprise servers.
Developed Chef automation and compliance validation workflows improving infrastructure consistency.
Maintained CI/CD systems supporting high-traffic guest-facing applications.

experience.summary: Supported enterprise cloud migration and infrastructure automation initiatives.
highlights: Migrated enterprise applications to AWS with high-availability architecture patterns.
Automated operational workflows resolving recurring infrastructure issues and improving reliability.

experience.summary: Built reliability-focused engineering solutions supporting healthcare claims processing platforms.
highlights: Reduced MTTR for claims processing systems through improved validation environments and operational tooling.
Maintained high availability and delivery reliability for business-critical batch systems.
